=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: tests/test_record_id_format_contract.py
  Line or code reference: line 16
  Problem: CONTRACTUAL_RECORD_ID_PATTERN uses [a-z0-9_]+ for the prefix group, which is stricter than what sanitize_segment actually preserves. sanitize_segment (scripts/ai_memory_lib.py line 174) replaces [^A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+ with underscores, so it preserves uppercase letters, dots, colons, and hyphens. The contractual regex rejects all of those.
  Why it fails at runtime: make_record_id(" Run Event ") returns a record ID whose prefix is Run_Event. CONTRACTUAL_RECORD_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch() would return None for this valid ID because the regex only matches lowercase prefix characters. The third test (test_make_record_id_preserves_current_mixed_case_space_sanitization_behavior) sidesteps this problem by using _assert_record_id_tail instead of the contractual regex, which means the test hides the mismatch rather than exposing it. Any caller feeding a prefix with a dot, colon, or hyphen through sanitize_segment would also produce output that fails the contractual regex.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: tests/test_record_id_format_contract.py
  Line or code reference: lines 33-39 (_assert_record_id_tail function) and lines 56-59 (test_make_record_id_preserves_current_mixed_case_space_sanitization_behavior)
  Problem: The third test bypasses CONTRACTUAL_RECORD_ID_PATTERN entirely by calling _assert_record_id_tail instead. _assert_record_id_tail only checks that the timestamp is 14 digits and the suffix is 10 lowercase hex characters. It does not validate the prefix against the contractual regex. This means the test passes even though the regex would reject its output, making the test a false negative.
  Why it fails at runtime: If someone later tightens the regex further, this test would still pass with _assert_record_id_tail, giving false confidence that the contract is satisfied. The test does not actually verify that mixed-case prefixes match the contractual pattern it claims to define.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
